name: Creamy Tomato Soup with Bacon-Jalapeño Grilled Cheese Sandwich (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 jalapeño pepper
1 small bunch green onion (scallion)
1 medium zucchini squash

instructions.primary_message: Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Trim green onions. Transfer both to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine, then spread out in an even layer. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping veggies halfway through, until charred, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly.

Meanwhile, preheat a large pot over medium heat. Once the pot is hot, add bacon and cook, turning occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve pot with drippings for later use.)
While the bacon is cooking, trim and roughly chop zucchini. Place in a small bowl.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the zucchini.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium yellow onion
1 clove garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the bacon is done, return the pot (with drippings) to medium-high heat. Add zucchini, onion, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp oregano, dried
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broth, tomatoes, and tomato sauce to the pot. Bring soup to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer until thickened slightly, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ cups chicken or vegetable broth
1 (411 g) can diced tomatoes
106 ml tomato sauce

instructions.primary_message: While the soup is cooking, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, place half of the bread slices on a flat surface. Top with cheese, then cover sandwiches with the remaining bread slices.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 slice white bread
¾ cup cheddar cheese, shredded

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Place sandwiches in the skillet and cook, flipping once, until bread is golden brown and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a cutting board, then slice each sandwich lengthwise into 4 grilled cheese "dippers." Set aside for the kid plates. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, roughly chop cooled jalapeño and green onion. Place in the reserved bowl, along with mayo, then stir to combine.

Place sourdough on a flat surface. Spread jalapeño mayo over half of the slices, then top with crispy bacon and cheese. Close sandwiches with remaining sourdough, then gently press to secure ingredients.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 slice sourdough bread
¾ cup cheddar cheese, shredded

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to medium heat. Add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Place sandwiches in the skillet and cook, flipping once, until bread is golden brown and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer sandwiches to a cutting board and slice in half.

When the soup is done, add cream and vinegar to the pot, then stir to combine. Using a hand blender, purée until smooth. (If using a regular blender, work in batches as needed, then return soup to the pot.) Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup heavy whipping cream
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar

instructions.primary_message:
FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide 2 cups of soup between bowls. Serve with grilled cheese dippers on the side. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining soup between bowls. Serve with jalapeño-bacon grilled cheese and enjoy!
